question: When Is Never-Ending Pasta at Olive Garden?
quick_answer: In 2026, Olive Garden's Never-Ending Pasta Bowl runs nationwide from August 31 to November 22. It starts at $14.99 and comes with unlimited pasta refills plus unlimited soup or salad and breadsticks. It is dine-in only. After November 22 the deal ends, and it usually comes back in late summer or early fall the next year.
key_facts: 2026 dates: August 31 to November 22 (eClub members and Pasta Pass holders got in from August 24)
Starts at $14.99, with unlimited soup or salad and breadsticks
4 pastas, 6 sauces and 4 toppings, for up to 120 combinations
Dine-in only; the $100 Pasta Pass sold out

body.heading: 2026 Never-Ending Pasta dates
body.text: Olive Garden brought the Never-Ending Pasta Bowl back nationwide on August 31, 2026, and it runs through November 22, 2026, a 13-week window. Members of Olive Garden's free eClub email list and Pasta Pass holders got early access from August 24. Once November 22 passes, the bowl comes off the menu until next year.

body.heading: How much it costs and what you get
body.text: The bowl starts at $14.99. For that you can keep ordering fresh bowls of pasta with your choice of sauce, and each meal also comes with unlimited soup or salad and breadsticks. Adding a protein topping costs $4.99 each, and prices can vary a little by restaurant. Like Olive Garden's other bottomless deals, the refills are for dine-in guests only.

body.heading: Pastas, sauces and toppings for 2026
body.text: The 2026 menu has four pastas (fettuccine, spaghetti, angel hair and rigatoni), six sauces (Alfredo, Spicy Alfredo, Meat Sauce, Five Cheese Marinara, Traditional Marinara and Creamy Mushroom) and four toppings (Crispy Chicken Fritta, Crispy Shrimp Fritta, meatballs and Italian sausage). Spicy Alfredo and Crispy Shrimp Fritta are new this year and limited-time. Olive Garden says that adds up to 120 possible combinations.

body.heading: What about the Never-Ending Pasta Pass?
body.text: For the first time since 2019, Olive Garden sold a Never-Ending Pasta Pass in 2026. It cost $100 plus tax and gave holders unlimited Never-Ending Pasta Bowl meals for 13 weeks, from August 24 to November 22. Only 10,000 passes were sold, starting July 16, and they sold out. The pass covers dine-in meals only and cannot be shared.

body.heading: When will it come back?
body.text: Olive Garden has not announced 2027 dates yet. The bowl has returned every year, but the start date moves: it began September 25 in 2023, August 25 in 2025 and August 31 in 2026. Joining the eClub is the easiest way to hear about it first, since members usually get a week of early access. Outside the promotion, you can still get unlimited soup or salad and breadsticks with regular entrees.

faqs.q: Is Olive Garden's Never-Ending Pasta still going on?
faqs.a: Yes, until November 22, 2026. The promotion started August 31 and ends that day.

faqs.q: How much is the Never-Ending Pasta Bowl?
faqs.a: It starts at $14.99 and includes unlimited soup or salad and breadsticks. Protein toppings cost $4.99 extra each.

faqs.q: Can I get Never-Ending Pasta to go?
faqs.a: No. The unlimited refills are for dine-in guests only.

faqs.q: Can you still buy the Olive Garden Pasta Pass?
faqs.a: No. Olive Garden sold 10,000 passes at $100 each starting July 16, 2026, and they sold out.

faqs.q: When does Never-Ending Pasta come back in 2027?
faqs.a: Olive Garden has not said yet. In recent years it has returned between late August and late September.
